business_scope: static beginner Transformer inference lesson using synthetic IM document questions and toy attention/cache arithmetic
prerequisites: 14.02 vectors, dot products and sample caveats
14.09 first-pass scoped question and keyword baseline
first_pass: separate application document filtering and IM contract validation from Transformer computation
use one simple weighted-value toy example before the real scaled-dot-product formula
distinguish position, causal masks, heads and layers without anthropomorphizing heads
trace prefill, first token and incremental decode
separate position-attention weights from output-token probabilities and explain greedy versus sampling
second_pass: calculate a two-KiB KV cache for the complete 32-token toy sequence and about twenty KiB for ten independent requests
limit the 32-token context subtraction to a fictional request with omitted overhead
treat KV prefix reuse as dependent on model, prompt, document version and authorization scope
measure TTFT and decode separately before blaming model or cache
keep q-01 current six-byte answer and q-03 permission refusal as user-result gates
not_yet_prerequisites: actual model, tokenizer, hardware, prompt and permitted-corpus measurements
upstream_inspection: No OpenIM implementation claim is needed. Transformer and KV-cache sources explain generic mechanisms; toy cache bytes and attention weights are not measured model behavior.
